name: Swarm Reverb
description: A cavern built from a swarm of short echoes instead of a smooth tail, with a Drag control that stretches the whole cave and bends everything in it in pitch.

params.name: Length
params.description: How long the swarm of echoes after each note lasts. Short is a tight cluster close behind the note, long is a slow scatter across a huge cave. Moving it bends what is already ringing.

params.name: Diffuse
params.description: Blurs the echoes into each other. At zero each one patters separately; turned up they smear into a wash.

params.name: Reflect
params.description: How much of the swarm is sent round again. Low is one rush of echoes, high is a cave that rings for a long time, and at the very top it never dies and slowly feeds on itself.

params.name: Dampen
params.description: How bright the cave is. Lower settings take the top off the echoes, and more of it each time they go round.

params.name: Drag
params.description: Stretches or shrinks every echo at once. While it moves, everything in the cave bends in pitch: down as the cave grows, up as it shrinks. The middle is the size set by Length.

params.name: Drag Time
params.description: How quickly the cave follows Drag. Fast gives a sharp jump in pitch, slow a long glide.

params.name: Steps
params.description: With Steps on, Drag moves between seven sizes related by octaves, fifths and fourths, so every move is heard as a musical interval instead of a free bend.

params.name: Wander
params.description: Lets Drag drift on its own so the cave keeps shifting. Smooth and seasick with Steps off; occasional interval jumps with Steps on.

params.name: Modulation
params.description: Slow, independent movement of each echo. A little keeps the swarm from ringing like metal; a lot makes it shimmer and detune.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Removes bass from the echoes, and more of it each time they go round, so the cave does not turn to mud.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo width of the echoes only. Zero is a mono cave; full spreads the swarm across both sides.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry sound and the cave.
